programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: DreamKeeper
programme.desc: The film opens with Eagle Boy, a young man who is on a vision quest. It then cuts to the present, where a 17-year-old Lakota named Shane Chasing Horse is living on the Pine Ridge reservation. He is in trouble because he owes some money to a local gang—money he used to buy a beautiful ring for Mae Little Wounded, a girl he likes. Meanwhile, his mother asks him to drive his grandfather, Pete Chasing Horse, a storyteller, down to the powwow. Shane is reluctant. However, when the gang comes after him, Shane changes his mind and heads out to the powwow with his grandfather, who agrees to give him his truck once they reach the powwow. Grandfather tells Shane the story of a young Lakota man who tries to win the hand of Bluebird Woman. He also tells the story of how a thunder spirit falls in love with a Mohawk woman and brings her up into the ethereal world of Sky Woman, and of how she raised their son back in her village until he was struck by one of the villagers and brought back to live with his father.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Virtus" - "Barcelona"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: LaLiga. Barcelona - Villarreal
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Bundesliga. Dortmund - Bayern
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. programme.title: EuroLeague. Hapoel TA - Paris
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity, all shot with breath-taking brio and the latest technology to reveal the continent and its animals in all its breath-taking glory.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Mountains. Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt... or die trying.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Return of the Predators
programme.desc: After 30 years of war and destruction, Gorongosa National Park in Mozambique has undergone a remarkable restoration. Herbivores once again bound across the plains, but hunters have been slower to return, leaving the park out of balance...until now!

programme.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programme.desc: National Geographic filmmaker Bertie Gregory travels to the gateways to the poles to film wildlife in two of the harshest environments on the planet: South Georgia Island above Antarctica, and Canada's frigid North below the Arctic Circle. Surviving in these vastly different environments require cunning, persistence and the ability to adapt to a changing climate. This is the story of Bertie's quest to capture these wild environments firsthand.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: Since ancient times, humans have had tangled bonds with snakes. Across the Americas and Australia, diverse habitats host venomous vipers and powerful constrictors, each evolved to fill their niche. In the Americas, over 30 rattlesnake species curb rodent populations, sustaining ecosystems. Meanwhile, Australia's coral reefs hide even deadlier sea snakes and the elusive, extremely venomous coastal taipan. From lush forests to desert sands and ocean depths, these continents harbor a hidden world of some of the most lethal, fascinating and secretive serpents.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: British author, television presenter and wildlife expert, Nigel Marven, travels the world to find the deadliest species of snake. In each episode Marven travels to a new country or continent and reveals the top 10 deadliest snakes that inhabit that region. From Costa Rica's black-headed bushmaster to South Africa's infamous black mamba, China's king cobra to Mexico's terciopelo, we uncover the most dangerous snakes on our planet. Known for his bold and impulsive approach to animals in the wild, Marven must be on full alert, as a bite from these slithering serpents could paralyse or even kill him.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads to the mysterious blue depths to discover which animal dominates the sea. His first encounter is with a tiger shark, the notorious hunter shaped like a torpedo and armed with ferocious teeth! Next, Phil dives with a group of magnificent manta rays and listens to the songs of one of the largest creatures on Earth, the majestic humpback whale.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Docs at Critter Fixer use humor & other de-stressing techniques to cope with the high-stakes challenges of aiding a rat attacked by a dog, removing a ruptured egg from a beautiful bird & saving a canine from a life-threatening condition. Lighter visits include a puppy's 1st exam, a cat losing fur, a guinea pig with an eye scratch, a constipated tortoise & a bearded dragon gender reveal party!

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the mangroves to discover which animal is truly built to survive the mud and muck. He encounters a feisty mud crab with huge pincers and catches a shovel-nosed ray with his bare hands. Finally, Phil faces a creature we all love to hate—the mosquito—and discovers there's more to these tiny bloodsuckers than meets the eye.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Path of the Panther
programme.desc: "These animals are like ghosts," says Carlton Ward Jr.—National Geographic explorer, photographer, and 8th generation Floridian—at the beginning of this captivating film that endeavors to keep the Florida Panther from becoming just that: a ghost. As the last big cat surviving in the eastern United States and the state animal of Florida, the panther is an icon of Florida's ever-diminishing wild places, as revealed in the film's sumptuous images. Leading a team that includes cowboys, wildlife biologists, photographers/videographers, and a lot of folks who simply care about the future of Florida's fragile ecology, Ward treks repeatedly into the Everglades and expanses of South Florida to seek, record, and save these ghosts.

programme.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programme.desc: National Geographic filmmaker Bertie Gregory travels to the gateways to the poles to film wildlife in two of the harshest environments on the planet: South Georgia Island above Antarctica, and Canada's frigid North below the Arctic Circle. Surviving in these vastly different environments require cunning, persistence and the ability to adapt to a changing climate. This is the story of Bertie's quest to capture these wild environments firsthand.

programme.title: Incredible Animal Journeys
programme.desc: Polar Parenting. The Arctic is a tough place to be a parent. Join the polar parents setting out to beat the odds in a world that's changing faster than ever before.

programme.title: Attack of the Big Cats
programme.desc: There are nearly 40 different species of cats running around out there, but only four make it into the big cat club. The lion, tiger, leopard and jaguar. And they're armed with an arsenal of weapons and bulk to back up one hell of an attitude. In their world, nothing is small and many things are surprising. So get ready to find out what really makes a big cat a big cat. It's not always all about size, you know.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Rare Cat Skills
programme.desc: Rare wild cats showcase extraordinary skills for survival. Over millennia, each species evolved with unique adaptations to suit their environment. The Pallas's cat blends into China's rocky steppes, the black panther hunts in India's forest shadows, and the snow leopard scales icy Himalayan peaks. Every camouflage trick, extraordinary skill and heightened sense are their keys to survival.

programme.title: The Flood
programme.desc: Incredible nature documentary series, narrated by amazing actress Angela Bassett, presents a two-part journey through the life cycle of one of the planet's last real wildernesses and tells the captivating tale of varios animals that live in the heart of Africa's Okavango Delta. Surrounded by the Kalahari Desert, the delta is a place of spectacular natural dramas where the lives of tens of thousands of animals each year depend on The Great Flood. Okawango welcomes leopards, elephants, lions, hippos,... each year as the great flood returns water to the habitat, and when the waters recede, the battle for survival begins.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Canadian computer-animated television series Top Wing presents an exciting story of four courageous young birds, Swift, Penny, Brody, and Rod on Big Swirl Island. programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. programme.desc: After Hazel makes her one-millionth wish, Cosmo and Wanda promise her one rule-free wish as a reward. But when their magic doesn't work, they take a trip to Fairy World to investigate and discover Dev has taken control. Fed up with living in Hazel's shadow, he's teamed up with Irep to give control of the Big Wand to anti-fairies and now kids all over the world have the opportunity to grant wishes rule-free. Before Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda can stop Dev, he traps Cosmo and Wanda in butterfly net cages and sends Hazel back home without her fairies to help her. While in power, Dev changes Fairy World to his own image and liking, and even reveals the existence of magic to everyone on Earth. It's total chaos. With the fate of Fairy World on her shoulders, Hazel enlists the help of Jasmine, Winn, Antony, and a few magical friends from past wishes, to rise up against Dev and his anti-fairy forces. Hazel must save Cosmo, Wanda, Peri, and Fairy World, before making a very special rule-free wish.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Strasbūro RC - Lanso RC
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: Un cast di stelle per la rivisitazione di un avventuroso classico. Lo spavaldo D'Artagnan si unisce ai moschettieri del Re per smascherare gli intrighi del Cardinale Richelieu.

programme.title: Geostorm
programme.desc: Disaster-movie con Gerard Butler. Una rete di satelliti che controlla le condizioni climatiche della Terra sfugge al controllo: uno scienziato deve impedire una tempesta globale.

programme.title: Tolo Tolo
programme.desc: Checco Zalone dirige e interpreta la commedia campione d'incassi scritta con Paolo Virzi. Inseguito dai creditori, Checco fugge in Africa, ma una guerra ne scombina i programmi.

programme.title: Cult Killer
programme.desc: Alice Eve, Antonio Banderas e Shelley Hennig in un crime-thriller di Jon Keeyes. Irlanda: per indagare sull'omicidio del suo mentore, una detective privata stringe la più insospettabile delle alleanze, portando alla luce un infernale mondo sommerso, regolato da abusi e corruzione.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: L'illusione perfetta: Now you see me, now you don't
programme.desc: I 'Quattro cavalieri' e una nuova generazione di illusionisti uniscono le forze per rubare il diamante più grande del mondo a un magnate sudafricano a capo di un'organizzazione criminale internazionale.

programme.title: Tre ciotole
programme.desc: Una coppia, Marta e Antonio, dopo quello che sembrava un banale litigio, si lasciano. Ognuno reagisce alla rottura in maniera diversa: Marta si chiude in se stessa e il suo appetito sparisce. Antonio, invece si butta completamente nel lavoro.

programme.title: Lucy
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Morgan Freeman nel fanta-action di Luc Besson. Un criminale inietta una misteriosa sostanza chimica nel corpo di una studentessa che sviluppa poteri sbalorditivi.

programme.title: Enzo
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino in una lucida analisi sul bisogno di trovare un posto nel mondo. Enzo, 16 anni, decide di abbandonare la scuola e una vita agiata per diventare muratore.

programme.title: Jane Austen ha stravolto la mia vita
programme.desc: Agathe è affascinante quanto contraddittoria. È single, ma sogna una storia d'amore degna dei romanzi di Jane Austen. È libraia, ma sogna di diventare scrittrice. Ha un'immaginazione sfrenata, ma una sessualità inesistente.

programme.title: Sole a catinelle
programme.desc: Checco Zalone in una commedia travolgente. Un venditore di aspirapolveri ha promesso al figlio una vacanza da sogno. Un colpo di fortuna li condurra' in un mondo di feste esclusive.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: Due uomini trovano la più grande pepita d'oro mai scoperta e devono trovare un modo per dissotterrarla, ma il dubbio e l'avidità iniziano a farsi strada mentre i due mettono in atto il loro piano.

programme.title: Geostorm
programme.desc: Disaster-movie con Gerard Butler. Una rete di satelliti che controlla le condizioni climatiche della Terra sfugge al controllo: uno scienziato deve impedire una tempesta globale.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Cailee Spaeny nella pellicola di Sofia Coppola che racconta il grande e turbolento amore tra Priscilla Beaulieu e il re del rock and roll Elvis Presley (Jacob Elordi).

programme.title: Capone
programme.desc: Biopic sul famoso gangster con Tom Hardy, Linda Cardellini, Matt Dillon e Kyle MacLachlan. Uscito dal carcere, Al Capone ripercorre il suo passato mentre lotta contro la demenza senile.

programme.title: I mostri
programme.desc: Dino Risi dirige Vittorio Gassman e Ugo Tognazzi in uno dei manifesti della Commedia all'Italiana: un affresco dell'Italia degli anni 60 in venti memorabili episodi sul filo del grottesco.

programme.title: Finale a sorpresa - Official Competition
programme.desc: Penelope Cruz e Antonio Banderas in una commedia sul mondo del cinema. Per realizzare un film, un miliardario ingaggia un'eccentrica regista e due divi in competizione tra loro.

programme.title: La battaglia di Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al War movie di Mel Gibson con Andrew Garfield, da una storia vera. Seconda guerra mondiale: un soldato ottiene la medaglia al valore malgrado il rifiuto di impugnare le armi.

programme.title: Il capo perfetto
programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: Fuga da Alcatraz
programme.desc: Cult assoluto del cinema carcerario diretto da Don Siegel. Clint Eastwood è un detenuto in fuga dall'inespugnabile penitenziario di Alcatraz, amministrato da un sadico aguzzino.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.title: Anora
programme.desc: 5 Oscar e Palma d'oro a Cannes alla travolgente commedia di Sean Baker con Mikey Madison e Mark Eydelshteyn. Una spogliarellista di New York sposa il figlio miliardario di un oligarca russo, ma i suoceri inviano i loro sgherri negli Stati Uniti per annullare il matrimonio.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: Nel nome del padre
programme.desc: Biopic con Daniel Day-Lewis ed Emma Thompson diretti da Jim Sheridan, Orso d'oro a Berlino. La drammatica vicenda giudiziaria di 4 irlandesi condannati ingiustamente per terrorismo.

programme.title: E' stato il figlio
programme.desc: Toni Servillo in una vicenda grottesca di Daniele Cipri'. Dopo la morte della figlia, una famiglia palermitana spende il risarcimento in una Mercedes. L'automobile segnera' la loro rovina.

programme.title: Thelma
programme.desc: Una fantastica June Squibb è la trascinatrice di una action-comedy carica di humor. Los Angeles: vittima di una truffa telefonica, l'ostinata e orgogliosa novantatreenne Thelma si arma di coraggio e si avventura alla ricerca del delinquente che le ha estorto il denaro.

programme.title: Fuga da Alcatraz
programme.desc: Cult assoluto del cinema carcerario diretto da Don Siegel. Clint Eastwood è un detenuto in fuga dall'inespugnabile penitenziario di Alcatraz, amministrato da un sadico aguzzino.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: Al Pacino nel gangster-movie capolavoro di Brian De Palma, sceneggiato da Oliver Stone. Il rifugiato cubano Tony Montana scala i vertici della malavita e diventa il re del narcotraffico.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: Il signore delle mosche
programme.desc: L'avvistamento di una bestia semina il terrore nei campi rivali. Ralph e Piggy partecipano al banchetto di Jack nonostante l'avvertimento di Simon.

programme.title: Il signore delle mosche
programme.desc: Una violenta imboscata mette Piggy nei guai e Ralph si ritrova in inferiorità numerica.

programme.title: Il padrino
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Francis F. Coppola, con Marlon Brando e Al Pacino. Dopo l'attentato al padre, Mike comincia l'ascesa nella malavita a capo della famiglia Corleone.

programme.title: Dumb Money
programme.desc: Diretto da Craig Gillespie, il financial drama che ripercorre il caso GameStop, l'azienda salvata da un gruppo di investitori amatoriali a discapito di un gruppo di speculatori di Wall Street.

programme.title: Unbroken
programme.desc: Sceneggiato dai fratelli Coen, war movie biografico di Angelina Jolie. Seconda guerra mondiale: reclutato in aviazione, l'atleta Louis Zamperini finisce in mano ai giapponesi nel Pacifico.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: Jesse Eisenberg, Ed Harris e Clemence Poesy nel biopic su Marcel Marceau. Nella Francia occupata dai nazisti, il mimo si unisce alla Resistenza per salvare centinaia di bambini ebrei.

programme.title: Ligabue - 30 anni in un giorno
programme.desc: Ligabue fa i conti con i suoi ricordi e con la sua carriera nel biopic incentrato sul leggendario concerto di Campovolo del 2022.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: David Cronenberg dirige Viggo Mortensen in un thriller fra apparenza e realtà. Dopo aver ucciso 2 rapinatori per legittima difesa, un uomo si trova braccato da loschi individui.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Nureyev - The White Crow
programme.desc: Ralph Fiennes dirige Oleg Ivenko nella biografia del ballerino Rudolf Nureyev. Dall'infanzia in Urss alla richiesta di asilo politico a Parigi nel 1961: la vita di un'icona del XX secolo.

programme.title: C'era una volta il West
programme.desc: Henry Fonda e Claudia Cardinale nel western che ha consacrato il mito di Sergio Leone. Un magnate delle ferrovie ingaggia un killer per impadronirsi del terreno di un'ex prostituta.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Changeling
programme.desc: Biopic diretto da Clint Eastwood con Angelina Jolie. Los Angeles, 1928: una donna afferma che il bambino che le hanno riportato dopo un rapimento non è suo figlio, ma nessuno le crede.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: The Alto Knights - I due volti del crimine
programme.desc: Barry Levinson dirige Robert De Niro in un thriller dallo sceneggiatore di "Quei bravi ragazzi". New York, anni 50: per ottenere il controllo del mondo malavitoso, il boss Vito Genovese ordina di uccidere il rivale Frank Costello, che sopravvive miracolosamente all'attentato.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: Il mio nome e' Nessuno
programme.desc: Terence Hill e Henry Fonda nello 'spaghetti western' restaurato di Tonino Valerii, prodotto da Sergio Leone. Un anziano pistolero affronta l'ultima impresa prima di lasciare il Far West.

programme.title: Boogie Nights - L'altra Hollywood
programme.desc: Paul Thomas Anderson firma l'epopea di un promettente pornoattore, interpretato da Mark Wahlberg, sullo sfondo dei trasgressivi anni 70. Nel cast Heather Graham e Julianne Moore.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones e Alicia Vikander nel quinto capitolo della saga diretta da Paul Greengrass. Una nuova minaccia internazionale costringe l'ex agente Bourne a uscire dall'ombra.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Edward Norton nello spin-off della saga tratta dai romanzi di Robert Ludlum. L'agente Cross deve sfuggire all'eliminazione dei membri del programma Outcome.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Matt Damon nel primo capitolo della saga action. Ripescato in mare e sofferente di amnesia, l'ex agente segreto Jason Bourne cerca di ricostruire il suo passato e la sua identità.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Paul Greengrass dirige il secondo action con Matt Damon nei panni dell'ex agente della CIA. Lasciato indietro il passato, Bourne torna in campo per un'ingiusta accusa di omicidio.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum - Il ritorno dello sciacallo
programme.desc: Matt Damon nel terzo capitolo della saga action di Paul Greengrass, vincitore di 3 Oscar. Inseguito dalla Cia, Jason Bourne rincorre la verita' sul proprio passato.

programme.desc: Paul Greengrass dirige il secondo action con Matt Damon nei panni dell'ex agente della CIA. Lasciato indietro il passato, Bourne torna in campo per un'ingiusta accusa di omicidio.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum - Il ritorno dello sciacallo
programme.desc: Matt Damon nel terzo capitolo della saga action di Paul Greengrass, vincitore di 3 Oscar. Inseguito dalla Cia, Jason Bourne rincorre la verita' sul proprio passato.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones e Alicia Vikander nel quinto capitolo della saga diretta da Paul Greengrass. Una nuova minaccia internazionale costringe l'ex agente Bourne a uscire dall'ombra.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Edward Norton nello spin-off della saga tratta dai romanzi di Robert Ludlum. L'agente Cross deve sfuggire all'eliminazione dei membri del programma Outcome.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Matt Damon nel primo capitolo della saga action. Ripescato in mare e sofferente di amnesia, l'ex agente segreto Jason Bourne cerca di ricostruire il suo passato e la sua identità.

programme.desc: Jack Black, Cate Blanchett e Kyle MacLachlan in un intrigante fantasy di Eli Roth. L'orfanello Lewis si trasferisce a casa dell'eccentrico zio, scoprendo un mondo di incantesimi e streghe.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Ghosthunters - Gli acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: A caccia di spettri in una commedia fantastica. Tom fa amicizia con il fantasmino Hugo e chiede aiuto a un'investigatrice dell'occulto per aiutarlo a tornare a casa.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Baby Boss 2 - Affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Sequel dell'animazione di successo targata Dreamworks. Tim e Ted sono diventati adulti e si sono allontanati l'uno dall'altro, finche' una missione top secret non li costringe a riunirsi.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Avventure fantasy per Robin Williams. Due ragazzi rimangono intrappolati nei pericolosi labirinti di un gioco da tavolo e affrontano ogni tipo di insidia per liberarsi.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della spassosa saga animata con l'inarrestabile panda Po. Per affrontare il perfido Kai, Po insegna i segreti del kung fu ai miti abitanti del suo villaggio natale.

programme.title: Transformers One
programme.desc: Il prequel totalmente animato della saga sci-fi e' un'origin story che narra l'amicizia dei futuri nemici giurati Optimus Prime e Megatron, in fuga dalla Cyberton sotterranea, e il momento in cui acquisiscono i loro poteri.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - Amici per sempre
programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.title: Non si scherza col fuoco
programme.desc: La star del wrestling John Cena in una commedia per tutta la famiglia. Una squadra di vigili del fuoco salva tre fratelli da un incendio in una casa di montagna. In attesa di rintracciare genitori, i pompieri scoprono di non essere affatto addestrati a fare i babysitter.

programme.title: Trash
programme.desc: Tenera avventura animata, opera prima di Francesco Dafano e Luca Della Grotta. Slim, una scatola logora, e la bottiglia ammaccata Bubbles accompagnano il piccolo Spark, una batteria usata, alla ricerca della Piramide magica: il luogo dove tutti i rifiuti possono avere una seconda chance.

programme.title: Latte e la pietra magica
programme.desc: Animazione tratta dai libri di Sebastian Lybeck. Per scongiurare la siccità, una femmina di porcospino e il suo amico scoiattolo devono recuperare una magica pietra rubata da Re orso.

programme.title: Ghosthunters - Gli acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: A caccia di spettri in una commedia fantastica. Tom fa amicizia con il fantasmino Hugo e chiede aiuto a un'investigatrice dell'occulto per aiutarlo a tornare a casa.

programme.desc: Animazione rockeggiante Sky Original. Bodi e la sua band sono ormai gli idoli di Snow Mountain. Quando un impresario li scrittura per un tour scopriranno che la fama ha un prezzo.

programme.desc: Sofi', Lui' e i loro amici volano in Transilvania per impedire a Viperiana e alla banda di Malefici di impossessarsi di un potente diamante custodito nel castello del piu' temuto dei vampiri: il Conte Dracula.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film

programme.desc: Un gioiello di animazione diventato un classico. Un leone, una giraffa, un ippopotamo e una zebra evadono dallo zoo di New York per vivere rocambolesche avventure nella giungla.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Ricercati in Europa
programme.desc: Terza avventura e nuovo continente per il leone Alex, la zebra Marty, la giraffa Melman e l'ippopotamo Gloria, che si troveranno in Europa braccati dalla spietata agente DuBois.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.desc: Justin Lin dirige il terzo capitolo della saga reboot prodotta da J.J. Abrams. Negli angoli remoti dello spazio, un nuovo e misterioso nemico attende l'equipaggio dell'Enterprise.

Le sue dimensioni, inoltre, aumentano a dismisura. Un esperto di scimmie, Davis Okoye, che aveva stretto un affettuoso rapporto con il primate, vuole vederci chiaro. Indagando sull'accaduto scopre che altri animali sono stati sottoposti allo stesso trattamento. Un lupo e un coccodrillo stanno andando incontro alla medesima alterazione di George: serve al più presto un antidoto per fermare la loro rabbia distruttrice.

Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

La sua prossima sfida sara' recarsi a casa dell'uomo per conoscere la moglie...

programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.desc: Meg Ryan e Tom Hanks in un classico della commedia romantica. La proprietaria di una libreria flirta in rete con uno sconosciuto. Scoprira' che si tratta del suo rivale in affari.

programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Colleen Hoover, un dramma sentimentale con Blake Lively. Dopo il funerale del padre, Lily torna a Boston per aprire un negozio di fiori e si innamora di Ryle, un affascinante neurochirurgo, ma l'uomo possiede un lato oscuro e violento che sta per riaffiorare.

programme.title: Big Wedding
programme.desc: Commedia con Robert De Niro, Katherine Heigl, Susan Sarandon e Diane Keaton. In occasione delle nozze del figlio adottivo, due coniugi, separati da anni, fingono di andare d'accordo.

programme.desc: 6 Oscar al musical di Damien Chazelle con Ryan Gosling ed Emma Stone, premiata a Venezia. Mia, aspirante attrice, s'innamora di Sebastian, pianista jazz che sogna di aprire un night club.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: Sei mai stata sulla luna?
programme.desc: Raoul Bova e Liz Solari in una commedia romantica di Paolo Genovese. Una donna in carriera vorrebbe vendere la masseria che ha ereditato, ma deve sfrattare un affascinante contadino.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: 6 Oscar al musical di Damien Chazelle con Ryan Gosling ed Emma Stone, premiata a Venezia. Mia, aspirante attrice, s'innamora di Sebastian, pianista jazz che sogna di aprire un night club.

programme.desc: Domhnall Gleeson e Rachel McAdams in una commedia romantica di Richard Curtis. A 21 anni Tim scopre di poter viaggiare nel tempo e usa questa abilita' per sistemare la sua vita.

programme.title: In amore niente regole
programme.desc: George Clooney dirige e interpreta una commedia brillante con Renee Zellweger e John Krasinski. 1925: un capitano di football e un giovane fuoriclasse si innamorano della stessa donna.

programme.title: Tutti in piedi
programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.title: Nessuno mi puo' giudicare
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia di Max Bruno con Paola Cortellesi, Raoul Bova, Rocco Papaleo e Anna Foglietta. Dopo la morte del marito, una donna decide di diventare una escort per pagare i debiti (ITA 2011).

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: Duplicity

programme.desc: Grande successo in Francia per la pellicola di Gilles Lellouche. Una rapina finita male divide le strade di Jacqueline e Clotaire, ma la forza del primo amore resterà intatta...

programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Henry Golding in una romantica commedia scandita dalle canzoni di George Michael. Londra: Kate sbarca il lunario lavorando in un negozio durante il periodo natalizio, mentre coltiva il sogno di diventare una cantante. L’incontro con Tom cambierà la sua vita.

programme.title: Amici, amanti e...
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.title: Per tutta la vita
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Luca e Paolo, Ambra Angiolini e Claudia Gerini. Quattro coppie ricevono la notizia che il loro matrimonio e' stato annullato e devono ripresentarsi davanti all'altare.

programme.title: In amore niente regole

programme.desc: Toccante film Sky Original con i premi Oscar Susan Sarandon e Kate Winslet. Una donna gravemente malata riunisce la famiglia, ma i conflitti irrisolti destabilizzano l'ultimo saluto.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: Nour
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto nella pellicola di Maurizio Zaccaro sulla complessa realtà degli sbarchi dei migranti. Un dottore di stanza a Lampedusa prende a cuore il caso di una bambina siriana.

programme.title: In viaggio con Adele
programme.desc: Alessandro Haber, Sara Serraiocco e Isabella Ferrari in un toccante road movie. Un anziano attore scopre di avere una figlia e parte con lei per un viaggio che cambiera' le loro vite.

programme.title: Ariaferma
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Silvio Orlando nel dramma carcerario di Leonardo Di Costanzo che indaga il delicato rapporto tra secondini e detenuti, premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022.

programme.title: A Good Person
programme.desc: Florence Pugh e Morgan Freeman in un film Sky Original di Zach Braff. Sopravvissuta a un incidente, una giovane donna prova a ricostruire la sua vita con l'aiuto dell'aspirante suocero.

programme.title: Molto forte, incredibilmente vicino
programme.desc: Toccante storia con Tom Hanks e Max von Sydow, dal romanzo di Jonathan Safran Foer. Un bambino insegue il mistero di una chiave appartenuta al padre, morto nell'attentato dell'11 settembre.

programme.desc: Colin Farrell nel film targato Sky Original, premiato al Sundance Festival. Nel futuro, i membri di una famiglia devono fare i conti con il malfunzionamento dell'androide che vive con loro.

programme.desc: Uberto Pasolini dirige un film struggente con James Norton e Daniel Lamont. Affetto da una malattia incurabile, John vuole trovare una famiglia per suo figlio di quattro anni.

programme.title: Eterno visionario
programme.desc: Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Bruni Tedeschi nel biopic che racconta vita e arte di Luigi Pirandello. Il ritratto intimo del grande drammaturgo e la cronaca della sua esistenza, scandita dal rapporto burrascoso con la moglie e dall'amore per una giovane musa.

programme.title: Leonora addio
programme.desc: Paolo Taviani omaggia Pirandello in un film premiato a Berlino. Dopo la morte dello scrittore, un emissario comunale intraprende un viaggio da Roma ad Agrigento per trasportarne le ceneri.

programme.title: La notte più lunga dell'anno
programme.desc: Dramma corale con Ambra Angiolini. Potenza: attorno a un'area di servizio, la notte del solstizio d'inverno diventa il punto di svolta per un politico, una cubista e un gruppo di ragazzi.

programme.title: Holiday
programme.desc: Toccante pellicola di Edoardo Gabbriellini. Dopo un lungo processo e la prigione, Veronica viene scagionata dall'accusa di omicidio. Tornata in liberta', fatica ad avere una vita normale.

programme.title: Gioventù bruciata
programme.desc: Un classico intramontabile che consacrò il mito di James Dean. Nell'America degli anni '50 un gruppo di ragazzi inquieti e tormentati si ribella al mondo degli adulti. Una generazione allo sbando alla ricerca della propria strada, alla ricerca del brivido ogni oltre limite. Golden Globe a Natalie Wood, nel film d'esordio per un allora diciannovenne Dennis Hopper. Uscito nella sale americane a breve distanza dalla morte di James Dean, avvenuta proprio in un incidente stradale il 30 settembre 1955, quando l'attore aveva girato appena tre film.

programme.desc: Generazioni a confronto nel film di Giorgia Cecere con Claudia Gerini e Lucia Sardo. In Salento per vendere la villa di famiglia, Irene si scontra con il rifiuto dell'anziana governante.

programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek ritorna alla sua terra natale con tre cortometraggi. La musica, intorno alla tavola, aiuta a esprimere e condividere le emozioni.

programme.desc: Kevin Costner e Diane Lane in un dramma dai risvolti thrilling. Uno sceriffo e la moglie lasciano il ranch nel Montana per salvare la nuora e il nipote da una famiglia di criminali.

programme.desc: Riccardo Scamarcio e Lou de Laage nell'opera prima di Stephane Freiss. Una giovane, di famiglia ebrea ortodossa, incontra un uomo con cui esplora il desiderio di ribellarsi alla tradizione.

programme.desc: Will Smith è la star di un commovente dramma sul dolore e la perdita. Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Cate Blanchett in una pellicola di Woody Allen. Una donna in crisi lascia New York e si trasferisce a San Francisco per rimettere ordine nella sua vita.

programme.desc: Opera prima di Jasmine Trinca, con Alba Rohrwacher e Valeria Golino. La figlia di un'artista di strada vuole conquistare l'amore della madre, che sembra essere piu' legata al suo cane.

programme.desc: Un criminologo segue il caso di Elisa, una donna di 35 anni rinchiusa in prigione da 10 anni per il barbaro omicidio apparentemente immotivato della sorella e per averne bruciato il cadavere. Sostiene di ricordare poco o niente del delitto.

programme.title: A proposito di Schmidt
