programme.desc: Francesco Bruni dirige Kim Rossi Stuart in un racconto autobiografico sul tema della fragilita'. La diagnosi di una malattia costringe un regista a rivalutare i suoi legami personali.

programme.desc: Isabelle Huppert in un pellicola che entra nel cuore della politica. Prima di concludere il suo mandato, una sindaca vuole realizzare il piano di riqualificazione di una banlieu.

programme.title: Scomode verità
programme.desc: Mike Leigh dirige un potente dramma con Marianne Jean-Baptiste e Michele Austin. Pansy, una donna astiosa e irascibile, sempre in conflitto con il mondo, trova finalmente la forza di confessare il segreto che ferisce il suo animo durante una riunione di famiglia.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: L'ombra del giorno
programme.desc: Giuseppe Piccioni dirige Riccardo Scamarcio e Benedetta Porcaroli. Ascoli Piceno, 1938: un ristoratore filofascista s'innamora della sua nuova cameriera. Ma la ragazza nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: Beautiful Minds
programme.desc: Il valore dell'amicizia in un film on the road. Due uomini, soli e molto diversi, si ritrovano a viaggiare su un carro funebre verso il sud della Francia con una nuova leggerezza nel cuore.

programme.title: Cosa sarà
programme.desc: Francesco Bruni dirige Kim Rossi Stuart in un racconto autobiografico sul tema della fragilita'. La diagnosi di una malattia costringe un regista a rivalutare i suoi legami personali.

programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Berlino 2019 per il film di Claudio Giovannesi tratto dal bestseller di Roberto Saviano. Napoli: l'ascesa di un gruppo di giovanissimi nel mondo della criminalita'.

programme.title: Ubriachi d'amore
programme.desc: Commedia con Alec Baldwin e Salma Hayek. Dopo una sbronza colossale, due coniugi facoltosi, ma vicini alla bancarotta, mettono a punto un piano disastroso per tornare ricchi.

programme.title: Con chi viaggi
programme.desc: Gli YouNuts! dirigono una comedy on the road con Fabio Rovazzi, Lillo, Alessandra Mastronardi e Michela De Rossi. Una app di Car-Sharing riunisce 4 sconosciuti in un viaggio avventuroso.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Da grande
programme.desc: Renato Pozzetto in una delle sue commedia di maggior successo. Un bambino di otto anni esprime il desiderio di diventare adulto. Il miracolo si avvera e lui diventa un uomo di 40 anni.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson e Zac Efron nell'action comedy ispirata alla serie tv anni '90. Mitch e il suo team di bagnini devono sgominare una pericolosa banda di trafficanti di droga.

programme.title: Sapore di mare
programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: La fantasia incontenibile di Tim Burton per l'atteso sequel con Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder, Jenna Ortega e Monica Bellucci. Per salvare la figlia dal regno dei morti, Lydia stringe un patto con il dispettoso Beetlejuice, che a sua volta deve liberarsi dell'ex moglie Delores.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: George Clooney, Brad Pitt e il resto della banda nel terzo capitolo della saga. I professionisti del furto devono saccheggiare il casino' di un magnate interpretato da Al Pacino.

programme.title: The Parenting
programme.desc: Brian Cox e Lisa Kudrow in una commedia a tinte horror. Una coppia organizza un weekend per presentare i genitori, ma la casa in affitto è infestata da un poltergeist.

programme.title: La scuola più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Christian De Sica e Rocco Papaleo in una commedia di Luca Miniero. Un preside interessato al gemellaggio con una scuola ghanese invia per errore la proposta a un istituto napoletano.

programme.title: The Estate
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original con Kathleen Turner, Anna Faris, Toni Collette e David Duchovny. Due sorelle accorrono dalla ricca zia malata con la speranza di conquistarne la stima e... l'eredita'.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Il premio
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann dirige e interpreta una commedia con Gigi Proietti, Rocco Papaleo, Anna Foglietta. Uno scrittore con la paura di volare raggiunge Stoccolma in auto per ritirare il Nobel.

programme.title: Mollami
programme.desc: Road movie targato Sky Original diretto da Matteo Gentiloni. Un’adolescente problematica viene costretta dal padre ad andare in collegio, ma il viaggio non sarà semplice.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il re dei giochi
programme.desc: Giallo e risate nella prima commedia targata Sky Cinema tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Un incidente d'auto scatena le fantasie investigative di Massimo e degli arzilli vecchietti.

programme.title: Nati stanchi
programme.desc: Prima commedia da protagonisti per Ficarra e Picone. Due giovani siciliani disoccupati e svogliati partecipano ai concorsi e si presentano ai colloqui facendo in modo di non essere assunti.

programme.title: La scuola più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Christian De Sica e Rocco Papaleo in una commedia di Luca Miniero. Un preside interessato al gemellaggio con una scuola ghanese invia per errore la proposta a un istituto napoletano.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: George Clooney, Brad Pitt e il resto della banda nel terzo capitolo della saga. I professionisti del furto devono saccheggiare il casino' di un magnate interpretato da Al Pacino.

programme.title: Quando
programme.desc: Neri Marcorè e Valeria Solarino in un film di Walter Veltroni. Entrato in coma ai funerali di Berlinguer nel 1984, un uomo si risveglia dopo 31 anni. Sarà per lui una nuova rinascita.

programme.title: Miami Beach
programme.desc: Ricky Memphis e Max Tortora in una commedia vacanziera di Carlo Vanzina. Le spiagge e il mare della Florida incorniciano le comiche peripezie di un gruppo di ragazzi e dei loro genitori.

programme.title: Viva l'Italia
programme.desc: Graffiante commedia con Michele Placido, Alessandro Gassmann, Raoul Bova e Ambra Angiolini. Colpito da improvvisa demenza, un senatore perde ogni inibizione e non riesce più a mentire.

programme.title: Una terapia di gruppo
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Claudio Bisio diretta da Paolo Costella. Per errore, sei pazienti ricevono appuntamento dallo psicologo alla stessa ora con esiti inaspettati.

programme.title: La prima pietra
programme.desc: Corrado Guzzanti, Lucia Mascino e Kasia Smutniak in una graffiante commedia sull'Italia di oggi, scritta e diretta da Rolando Ravello. Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Il piccolo incidente innesca una serie di colpi di scena e reazioni inaspettate in un dibattito che coinvolgerà docenti, alunni e parenti. Tratto dall’opera teatrale di Stefano Massini. Rolando Ravello è stato fra gli sceneggiatori del fortunatissimo "Perfetti sconosciuti".

programme.title: Monty Python - Il senso della vita
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per l'ultimo capolavoro degli inimitabili Monty Python. La loro comicità visionaria esplode in una serie di sketch surreali e irriverenti.

programme.desc: Seconda commedia con Filippo Timi, tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il mistero sul passaggio di proprieta' di un terreno innesca una catena d'eventi e una nuova indagine.

programme.desc: Action-comedy con Charlize Theron, David Oyelowo, Joel Edgerton e Amanda Seyfried. Il manager di una compagnia farmaceutica finge di essere rapito per ottenere i soldi del riscatto.

programme.title: Colpi d'amore
programme.desc: Action-comedy con i premi Oscar Ke Huy Quan e Ariana DeBose. Un agente immobiliare, ex killer al servizio di un'organizzazione criminale, deve regolare i conti con il passato di cui pensava di essersi liberato e con la donna di cui era innamorato.

programme.title: Cetto c'e', senzadubbiamente
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo di successo per il carismatico personaggio di Antonio Albanese. La vita di Cetto in Germania e' scossa dalla rivelazione della zia morente: e' l'erede naturale di un principe.

programme.title: L'illusione perfetta: Now you see me, now you don't
programme.desc: I 'Quattro cavalieri' e una nuova generazione di illusionisti uniscono le forze per rubare il diamante più grande del mondo a un magnate sudafricano a capo di un'organizzazione criminale internazionale.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Olivia Wilde con una commedia sulla trasgressione. Per recuperare il tempo passato a studiare, due studentesse decidono di trascorrere una lunga notte di eccessi.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: An overworked and under loved Precious has to choose between the Templeton Family startup business or Crispin Biscuits’ fun playtime. Meanwhile, the company makes its first purchase: upgraded communicators! R \u0026 D Baby Simmons is reluctant to fix the model they have, which picks up signals from her favorite lvorian soap opera, “Bridges Aflame.” Over a live broadcast, Simmons must convince the cast to tie up every loose plot thread before she has to lose the signal forever.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Uncle Benji makes a surprise visit to the Templeton Family with a cute baby of his own: Lil Bit Guerrero! Tina gets jealous of Carol doting on Lil Bit, while Benji reveals that in order to make his daughter proud of him, he’s applied to become a Federal Agent. With Boss Baby’s cover at stake, it’s up to the Templeton Family to get Benji out of their hair as he sniffs around for a case that could garner the attention from federal law enforcement.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Yi and the crew are overrun with pings from humans who are frustrated by creatures they now live alongside. Just when they think they’ve solved one issue, another springs up – and then that original one pops up again too! Meanwhile, we see an ominous pedestal of light progressively become more cracked with each fraught human-creature relationship. At her wits’ end, Yi accidentally hurts Peng, Jin, and Everest with her magic. She then notices Everest fading into nothing….

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: In the wake of the previous episode, the magical creatures have all vanished and the world at large has gone gray. Desperate to fix things, the crew travels to the Magical Realm to confront the omniscient Great Watcher, who was a tempting offer for Yi. The kids manage to retrieve creatures, but being back in the human world is sapping them of their magical energy. Feeling responsible, Yi embarks on a dangerous mission to save everyone – but it’s the community of creatures and humans alike that instead come to Yi’s rescue. Together, they realize that their connections to one another are the most powerful magic of all.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Following the events of the feature, Yi struggles to recreate her violin magic without Everest. While her mom and NaiNai prepare for the grand opening of their family dumpling shop, Yi, Jin, and Peng discover that Yi’s violin has attracted a magical bird-like creature, Fenghuang, who needs their help. Yi’s music also calls on Everest, who returns to join the crew and find Fenghuang a suitable home.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: When Eep has the first-ever sleepover, scary noises and shadows send the girls screaming out of the cave; Thunk saves the day when Bear Owls invade.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: George and Harold transform the school's mysterious student into a giant clay monster who turns the entire town into clay.

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged
programme.desc: DStructs quest to find the location of the supercharger leaves him in a tight situation.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On!
programme.desc: When Branch loses to Poppy at Capture the Flag, he challenges her to break into his bunker and steal Gary, to prove her abilities. Poppy organizes a whacky heist with the help of the Snack Pack. /When Smidge accidentally loses some of the critters Milton cares for, she must try and retrieve them from Trolls Forest.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City

Feeling responsible, Yi embarks on a dangerous mission to save everyone – but it’s the community of creatures and humans alike that instead come to Yi’s rescue. Together, they realize that their connections to one another are the most powerful magic of all.

programme.desc: Cleve has the team surrounded – is this the end? Suddenly, Cisco bursts in to save the day, along with all of the friends the team has made along the way in the Sahara. Working together, they manage to stop Cleve’s missiles and defeat Rafaela and Matsuo. But before they get a chance to celebrate, a giant fire tornado tears its way through the Sahara destroying everything in its path. Tony decides to make one last daring attempt in order to save the day.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: The only way that Jim can remove Stricklers ring is if he stops time but he uses the time stopping artefact too soon..

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: When unexpected guests arrive bringing AAARRRGGHHs past and illness to light Jim finds himself competing in a terrifying game of Pyrobligst.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: Jim and Strickler team up to bring down Angor Rot Meanwhile the Gnome returns with important information regarding Baby Enrique.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: A bummed out Tina takes a vacation to the baby resort, Floaties! However, her mind is still back at work, and struggled to actually enjoy her vacation. And it gets worse when Crispin Biscuits switches electronic ID tags with her, causing everyone to assume Tina actually is Crispin Biscuits. With Crispin having booked her for a seemingly endless stay, Tina is trapped in a paradise nightmare, and in a tunnel of madness starts to think that she may even be Crispin.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits heists the underwater Baby Bank in an attempt to steal all the funds from Boss and Tina’s new company. Boss, Tina and Banker Baby Benny must infiltrate the bank via submarine to stop this high-stakes aquatic robbery. But Boss and Tina struggle to stay on the same page after Tina admits that she might, kinda, sorta be thinking about retiring as a regular baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After Crispin Biscuits changes the Baby Love economy to reward companies for bringing in baby hate, Boss Baby is forced to make himself the most hated baby in town to save their startup company. Meanwhile, Tina needs to end Crispin Biscuits’ attacks on their company before she can finally hang up her boss role and retire to a life of cuddle time with daddy and mommy.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: While Yi and the crew try to pinpoint how Yi’s magic works, they notice that Everest isn’t looking too hot. In fact, he’s too hot. The crew tries everything to cool him down, even begging their old foe, Burnish, for help. Out of options, Yi tries to use her magic to send Everest home – until Burnish and his jerboa sidekick, Duchess, reveal that they’ve made over the kids’ rooftop fort into a high-tech HQ, complete with various tech gadgets for the crew and a temperature-controlled chamber for Everest.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: An earth-shaking rumble signals the arrival of a new creature, but Yi and Jin butt heads, each convinced they’re the better team leader. The crew eventually discovers that the massive Sewer Koi is behind the earthquakes, but he’s missing his precious pearl, the key to a magical underground dam. Without it, the sewer’s water levels will rise, threatening to overflow and flood the whole city! It’s going to take a heist to extract the pearl from its display at a local museum, before it’s too late.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: With the sudden closing of a local candy shop, NaiNai is busy trying to recreate its famous candied fruit. But after a late-night sugar binge in NaiNai’s stash, Peng starts acting strangely. It turns out that he’s possessed by magical creatures! The Minticon are sugar-addicted puffball creatures, who previously lived in the old candy shop. Armed with her violin, Yi commands the creatures out of Peng’s body, winning over the Minticon in the process.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods
programme.desc: When Grug takes Ugga hunting to find her inner growl again, she's as fierce as ever until coming face-to-face with a mom and baby too cute to catch.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: George and Harold transform their new Spanish teacher into a superhero after they feel guilty for pranking him, but their teacher loves it and gets carried away.

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged
programme.desc: The team travels to the Wastelands not the Dooms. They meet the Speed Trux who convinces the team to participate in the Doom Run race to try and win the part they need to fix Skya.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On!
programme.desc: DJ is excited to give her niece CJ her own wooferbug for her birthday. But the wooferbug proves difficult to transport across Trolls Village. Will DJ be able to get it to CJ before CJ’s birthday party ends?/When Peppy takes an entire day to get a new haircut, he asks Poppy to fill him in on what he missed. What follows is a series of short sketches, as we explore an average day in Troll Village.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy
programme.desc: The PALs run into their old rivals the BUDs on the first day of classes, prompting Lucky to run for class rep. Elsewhere, Abigail helps solve a mystery.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender
programme.desc: The Paladins take the day off to spend with their friends and family before launching off to space again. Lance works up the courage to ask Allura out on a date.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Birch manages to convince Liam that Sandra's grade-threatening bad mood stems from boy trouble. In an effort to get her out of her funk and into studying again, the cousins invent a secret admirer for Sandra. They soon find Sandra's constant need for affirmation exhausting — a further complication in their attempt to keep up their group grade point average.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: When Sandra signs Pod 4 up for an academic quiz show, the kids are soon figuring out how to best leverage their TV exposure. It soon becomes obvious that four separate agenda do not add up to a cohesive team as they suffer near humiliation at the hands of the preppie team from Rydell High.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Raffi's win at the district art show hurtles Birch into the five stages of grief, her reactions throwing her podmates for a loop. Luckily, Liam's hip to what's going on thanks to a book Mr. Towes has assigned him. While Sandra trails Liam in hopes of seeing some emotional fireworks on Birch's part, Raffi can't quite get over the idea that Birch wouldn't be happy for his success.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Birch is initially aghast when Jason publishes her Manga “sample” in the school paper, but soon succumbs to the allure of popularity. As Birch's social status soars, her podmates become laughingstocks. Sandra's retaliation eventually brings the two girls together in their fight against the unethical editor of The Cosmos Chronicle.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Stingo has dispatched Slugsy to steal Fifi's jelly. Slugsy starts to play with the twins and forgets what he set out to do, much to Stingo's wrath!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Bumble is practicing for his magic show… but he has made the twins disappear! Can Fifi help him find them before the big show?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble fall out in a big way after Fifi doesn't show up to the picnic they are supposed to have together. How strange that Stingo is trying to get them to be friends again, or is it?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Diggly is bored of life on his compost heap and wants to see round the rest of the garden. Fifi offers to give him a guided tour. Diggly gets lost, how will he get home?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Pip is feeling bored and wants something new to play. Fifi has a brilliant idea and asks all the tots to help her build a playground for Pip as a surprise.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: It has been raining and the garden is muddy. The tots decide to make mud sculptures. But what will they all do with the sculptures when they are finished?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Stingo is bored and plays all manner of naughty tricks on the other tots. Fifi teaches Stingo that he will have more fun if he helps people rather than being mean to them.

programme.title: Maging Sino ka Man: Ang Pagbabalik
Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover’s death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: The Ultimate BROcation
programme.desc: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

programme.title: Army of One
programme.desc: Special Forces agent Brenner and her husband stumble upon an illegal drug compound in the woods while hiking. The drug dealers capture them, kill her husband, and leave her for dead. Not only does Brenner escape alive, she is also seething with rage and vows to hunt down all who murdered her husband and take revenge!

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. Season 2 features a first ever Thai female match and Season 3 has two Olympics gold medalists competing for the championship. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: A documentary series that focuses on first-class professionals from various fields.

programme.title: Magical Japanese \"Morning\"
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature and culture.This episode looks at words related to morning. Explore the unique words and the culture behind them.

programme.title: Macho Dancer
programme.desc: Pol moves to Manila for better opportunities after his American lover leaves. However, he gets drawn into the gritty world of gay prostitution and sexual slavery.

programme.title: King Arthur: Legend Of The Sword
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guy Ritchie brings his dynamic style to the epic fantasy action adventure \"King Arthur: Legend of the Sword.\" Starring Charlie Hunnam in the title role, the film is an iconoclastic take on the classic Excalibur myth, tracing Arthur's journey from the streets to the throne. When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy...whether he likes it or not.
